description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Ezreal''' [[File:Flash.png|20px|link=Blink|An icon representing the keyword Blink]] [[:Blink|blinks]] from his current location to up to 475 units towards the target location, then fires a homing bolt towards the nearest enemy that deals magic damage and [[File:Reveal icon.png|20px|link=Sight#Standard sight|An icon representing the keyword Standard sight]] [[:Sight#Standard sight|reveals]] them for 1 second.
description.text: Active: Ezreal blinks from his current location to up to 475 units towards the target location, then fires a homing bolt towards the nearest enemy that deals magic damage and reveals them for 1 second.

description2.raw: ''Arcane Shift'' prioritizes firing at the nearest enemy marked by ''[[File:Ezreal Essence Flux.png|20xpx|border|link=Ezreal#Essence Flux|An icon for Ezreal's ability Essence Flux]] [[Ezreal#Essence Flux|Essence Flux]]''.
description2.text: Arcane Shift prioritizes firing at the nearest enemy marked by Essence Flux.

description3.raw: ''The target does not have to be [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|visible]] to be hit by this ability.''
description3.text: The target does not have to be visible to be hit by this ability.

leveling.raw:
'''Magic Damage:'''
80 / 130 / 180 / 230 / 280 (+ 60% '''bonus''' AD) (+ 75% AP)

notes.raw:
* If '''Ezreal''' is moved during the cast time, his range to blink will update accordingly. This does not exceed the maximum target range.
* The target is revealed as soon as '''Ezreal''' fires the missile at them.
